_comment: Template. Copy to deploy.json and fill in your own values; deploy.json is
gitignored so real host addresses and paths stay out of version control.
The shape matters more than the values: the notes below are the parts that

source.pipeline_environment: a conda env with the GDAL 3.8+ Python bindings

runtime_services.name: fim-titiler
runtime_services.note: rasterTileBase must be a same-origin proxy path, not a private host:port. A cross-origin tile base needs CORS on the tile service and breaks under HTTPS.

cogs.note: The tile service must be able to read these by the same URL the browser sends.

pmtiles.note: Served as static files; needs HTTP byte-range support.
